save_checkpoint: save a training checkpoint state dictionary to a given file path using the checkpoint manager
save_snapshot: save a post-training model snapshot to a given file path using the checkpoint manager
load_checkpoint: load a checkpoint or snapshot from disk and return the deserialized state dictionary
list_checkpoints: list all saved checkpoint paths in the order they were saved using the checkpoint manager
get_latest_checkpoint: get the most recently saved checkpoint path from the checkpoint manager
